item.title: NFL wide receiver Rondale Moore dies at 25
item.description: The Floyd County, Indiana, coroner confirmed 25-year-old Rondale Moore died Saturday. An All-American at Purdue, Moore played a significant role in the Boilermakers’ win over Ohio State, which helped put Brohm on the college football coaching map.
